notes.title: Introducing Midnight Swamp!
notes.content:
Grab your backpack, go camping! Make your way through the forests and conquer the mountain peaks! Wait, something's wrong.. How did you end up in this impassable swamp?!

We are happy to announce that we are working on a new game! Midnight Swamp is a  grim point-and-click adventure where you dive into a world of dark fairy tales.

[previewyoutube=v5WMWm5k_TE;full][/previewyoutube]

What is it about?

Mysterious laughter echoed from the river on that restless summer night. Why the hell did you get out of the tent? You find yourself drawn into the gloomy world of Midnight Swamp, filled with strange inhabitants and thrilling puzzles.

Features:


A variety of puzzles, potion crafting, and location exploration
A dark swamp hiding a sinister secret
Many strange inhabitants to meet
Hand-drawn graphics


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078611/60885b1e0fbbc32fcd4e0d1f3c26aed50510aa53.jpg

We plan to release the game in early 2025. Meanwhile, we are working on a demo of the game for the Steam Next Fest: October 2024!
